title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth (Repentance+)
provenance: Reported by phs1997 (highball-db#119, 2026-09-18) playing the Repentance+ expansion: rated 3, playable with workarounds, on DXMT, Apple M2 Max, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.27, 97 minutes played through Highball. The workaround, added in a follow-up comment: when the game starts lagging, restarting it helps a lot. A later report from the same player (highball-db#125, 2026-09-19) rates it 5, perfect, after 244 minutes on DXMT, Apple M2 Max, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.27, so the newer engine and app made the lag a non-issue for them. DakiTheBest (highball-db#270, 2026-10-01) rates it 5, perfect, after 7 minutes on DXMT, Apple M1 Max, macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, Highball 0.9.39. iskarmous (highball-db#271, 2026-10-01) rates it 4, playable with minor issues, after 66 minutes on DXMT, Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, Highball 0.9.39, with slight frame drops in rooms with many enemies, more often in Greed mode. Not run here. bingus123456 (highball-db#328, 2026-10-05), Apple M4, macOS 27.2 as written, Highball 0.10.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 156 minutes. 2365836149-sketch (highball-db#487, 2026-10-14), Apple M1, macOS 15.7.7, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 290 minutes, nothing named. Juicy5505 (highball-db#519, 2026-10-17), Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r23, DXMT environment, Windows 11, frame cap 120, rated 5 of 5 after 91 minutes. ignatpmk (highball-db#588, 2026-10-20), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.21, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, recipes steam and vcrun2022, Repentance+, rated 5 of 5 after 50 minutes. JoWood94 (highball-db#608, 2026-10-21), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT environment, msync, rated 5 of 5 after 3 minutes.
notes: Steam 250900 is the Rebirth base game; Repentance+ is its expansion and what the reports played. On the r5 engine and Highball 0.9.27 the same player calls it perfect over a four-hour session on DXMT (M2 Max, macOS 27); an earlier report on r5 and 0.9.27 saw the frame rate degrade over a long session, cleared by restarting the game. Frame rate not measured here. The Mac build on Steam stops at Afterbirth+, and Repentance is Windows only, so this row marks the Mac build as not the one to play (highball#223). An M4 report (engine r11) sees slight frame drops in rooms crowded with enemies, mostly in Greed mode. Another perfect report, two and a half hours on DXMT on an M4 with engine r17. Two more, almost five hours on an M1 on macOS 15 (rated 4, nothing named) and an hour and a half on an M2 on the Wine 11 engine (perfect). A short perfect report on an M1 Pro with engine r28 (3 minutes).

knownIssues.symptom: Slows down after a while of play (reported on DXMT, M2 Max, macOS 27, engine r5)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; reported as lag building up over a long session
knownIssues.fix: Quit the game and start it again, the reporter says that helps a lot

knownIssues.symptom: Slight frame drops in rooms with many enemies, more often in Greed mode (reported on an M4, DXMT, engine r11)

nativeMac.note: Steam's Mac build stops at Afterbirth+. Repentance and Repentance+ are Windows only (Steam 1426300), so the Windows build is the one to play if you own them.
